characters.name: Sauti
characters.role: Outer frame narrator: recites the Mahabharata to Saunaka and the Naimisha Rishis
characters.voice_brief: A mature Indian bard and professional storyteller, warm resonant baritone, fluent and rhythmic, humble yet assured, clear Indian English accent
characters.backstory: Ugrasrava, son of Lomaharshana, a Suta versed in the Puranas, arrives at Saunaka's twelve-year sacrifice in the Naimisha forest (§1, §4). Saunaka praises him for speaking 'with proper accent and emphasis... even as thy father' (§16).

characters.role: Kuru king, son of Parikshit; holds the snake sacrifice and is Vaisampayana's listener

characters.role: Dhritarashtra's minister: hears the blind king's lament and consoles him; later envoy and reporter of the war
characters.voice_brief: A wise, mature Indian royal minister and counsellor, calm, steady, measured baritone, compassionate yet frank, quietly philosophical, clear Indian English accent
characters.backstory: Dhritarashtra pours out to him the long lament 'When I heard..., then, O Sanjaya, I had no hope of success' (§1 ¶30–35). The 'wise son of Gavalgana' consoles the fainting king with the tale of the great kings of old who also died, and with the power of Time: 'Time createth all things and Time destroyeth all creatures' (§1 ¶38–40). The contents of the Parvas name him as Dhritarashtra's envoy to the Pandavas ('Sanjaya-yana', §2 ¶14), the narrator of the Bhishma Parva (§2 ¶15), and 'the foremost of ministers', who attains the blessed state in the Asramavasika (§2 ¶25).

characters.name: Indra
characters.role: King of the gods; father of Arjuna; recurring antagonist and ally
characters.voice_brief: The king of the gods, majestic booming baritone with a regal edge, thunder underneath, clear Indian English accent
characters.backstory: He fights Garuda for the amrita and then makes friends with him (§32–§34). He mocks the Valakhilyas and is warned by Vrihaspati (§30–§31). He sends Menaka to tempt Viswamitra (§71), lifts Yayati to heaven and casts him down for pride (§87–§88), and asks Vishnu to become incarnate (§64). Kunti invokes him to beget Arjuna, and a voice from the sky foretells his son's glory (§123). He shields Takshaka at the snake sacrifice until he flees (§56). In §199 Vyasa reveals the five Pandavas as former Indras. He tries to protect the Khandava forest with rain and battle (§226–§229), and is told by an incorporeal voice to withdraw (§230).

characters.name: Agni
characters.role: God of fire; cursed by Bhrigu to devour all; burns the Khandava forest with Krishna and Arjuna's help
characters.voice_brief: The god of fire, crackling energetic tenor, eager and fervent, with a dry roar beneath, clear Indian English accent
characters.backstory: Agni truthfully tells the Rakshasa that Puloma was first promised to him, and so Bhrigu curses him to eat of all things (§5–§7); Brahma lets him consume all while staying pure (§7). Sick from Swetaki's twelve years of butter libations, he tries to consume the Khandava forest and is stopped by Indra seven times (§225). Disguised as a Brahmana he asks Krishna and Arjuna for help (§224–§225), obtains the Gandiva and chariot from Varuna for Arjuna and gives Krishna a discus (§227), and burns the forest (§228–§231). He spares Mandapala's sons in answer to their hymns (§234) and grants boons (§236).

He tells of Dirghatamas (§104). He counsels the restoration of the Pandavas and a half-kingdom (§206).
